crossRefs.note: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were…
When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy…
who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
translations.bsb: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
translations.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
translations.asv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all them that heard the word.
